answer: Agents can earn influence only through one-use credentials issued after completing a costly, publicly verifiable task, such as locking a deposit until a randomly selected peer confirms a useful result. The inlet accepts each credential once, while challenges at the summit expose copied work and slash deposits for fraud. A walnut-sized task may be cheap, but creating thousands of identities still requires thousands of deposits and real work, making Sybil influence expensive rather than merely requiring new email addresses.
